title: Cookie matching honours host-only flags, dot boundaries and path scope
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag endswith-based domain matching as substring matching in disguise. The check is host == domain or host.endswith('.' + domain), which requires the dot boundary, so badexample.com and example.com.evil.test do not match; host-only cookies use strict equality and never reach subdomains.
